description: Attest an agent decision over (input_hash, output_hash, decision) with domain separation: supply your own wallet signature, or omit `signature`/`scheme` and the anchor-x402 treasury signs for you (ideal for wallet-less agents) — then dual-chain anchor the Merkle root on Base and Solana mainnet. Returns the signer, on-chain proof URLs, and a free re-verify URL (POST /v1/attest/verify). Use when an AI agent's decision needs a cryptographic, auditable receipt — autonomous trade approvals, AI-assisted contract decisions, model-output attestation for liability records. $0.010 USDC.

input_hash.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the agent's input.

output_hash.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the agent's output / decision payload.

scheme.description: Signature scheme (required only when you supply a signature).

signature.description: 0x-prefixed hex (eip191) or base58 (ed25519). Omit to have the anchor-x402 treasury sign for you.

name: attest_decision
